dialog.string: Your favorite evoli evolution is : AQUALI !!
You are a calm and balanced individual, much like Aquali. You value stability
and consistently seek harmony in your life. With an intuitive side, you are
often in tune with your emotions. Human relationships are crucial to you,
and you strive to maintain a pleasant atmosphere around you. However,
at times, you may find it challenging to make tough decisions,
opting to avoid conflicts rather than confront them directly.
